# Membrane WAV Plugin v0.10.3 - Table of Contents

> Membrane Multimedia Framework plugin for WAV

## Pages

- [Membrane WAV Plugin](https://membrane-wav-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-wav-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.WAV.Parser](https://membrane-wav-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WAV.Parser.md): Element responsible for parsing WAV files.
- [Membrane.WAV.Postprocessing](https://membrane-wav-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WAV.Postprocessing.md): Module responsible for post-processing serialized WAV files.
- [Membrane.WAV.Serializer](https://membrane-wav-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WAV.Serializer.md): Element responsible for raw audio serialization to WAV format.
